## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
Population is the underlying of statistics.
As you will see throughout this book separating understandig the differences between the same terms used in different field, science vs colloquial is one major goal of this book.
This is a book about applied stat, and the main audience are ecologists and biologists, or at least those working with natural science.
Here we will attempt to link what is meant by population in natural science and population in statistics.

In statistics, things are defined more precisely.

The most important part is that most of statistics is not studying the whole population.
The goal is to sample from that population so we can estimate its proriety, somehow extrapolate.
Only rarely, we will have access to the real population.
